sources.quote: Fireworks AI discloses new breach after cloud provider hack
AI infrastructure startup Fireworks has disclosed a new security breach in which attackers accessed its development machines after breaching a third-party cloud provider.
Fireworks AI gets burned twice as customer data exposure widens
Inference biz pins latest breach on cloud provider and LLMJacking miscreants

claims.statement: Fireworks AI disclosed a new breach after attackers accessed its development machines via a third-party cloud provider hack.

analysis.headline: Fireworks AI discloses new breach tied to cloud provider hack
analysis.summary: AI infrastructure startup Fireworks disclosed a new security breach after attackers reached its development machines through a hack of a third-party cloud provider, widening a customer data exposure the company pins partly on LLMJacking attackers.

problems: cluster: analysis is for version 1, cluster is at version 2
